- BeamNG.drive stock assets (road signs, shapes, materials) are referenced from the game, not copied. BeamNG GmbH, used under the game's EULA.

### beamng_earth_ref

- BeamNG.Earth (MIT): reference only, engine measurements and UK marking dimensions. No code copied.

### earthng_ref

- EarthNG: reference only, road-audit ideas. No code copied.

### mapillary

- Mapillary street photos (CC BY-SA 4.0) are used as evidence for road fixes. Images are never committed.

## Google Maps

No Google Maps content is used anywhere in this project: not Maps, Street View, Earth or Places data, in data, prompts or fixes.

## Notes

- Data and photos from the sources above stay on the author's PC. Only derived fix data (`data/overrides/`) and code are committed, and each fix names its evidence.
- Third-party code is read before use and pinned to a commit.
